criteria.rule: Evaluate computational strength, design contribution, relevant-data support and reuse.
local_evidence: Three separate model studies: reader transport/optics, odor decoding, receptor engineering.
Measured versus simulated optical comparison, day-held-out decoder evaluation, matched receptor feature comparisons and structural controls.
gaps: KT corpus citation and redistribution unresolved; matching PN–KC–MBON training engine, fitted preprocessing, fold tables and seeds absent from the documented release.
Optical comparisons differ in source conditions; off-diagonal association is weak and does not validate arbitrary mixture correction.
Docking/MD candidates do not establish engineered receptor improvement or complete ligand passage.
criteria.status: Substantive award evidence; reproducibility and transfer gaps remain.

criteria.rule: Evaluate synthetic-biology need, user-feedback learning, demonstrated function and reproducibility.
local_evidence: Assembled eight-part reader, four frequency channels,58 dye acquisitions, explicit calibration checks and raw-data records.
One assembly-feedback record led to manual corrections; CAD,firmware,BOM and manuals are linked.
Living-cell time courses preserve differing trajectories and absolute-level changes.
gaps: Independent timed usability retest not established.
Simultaneous-loading additivity fails; source-matrix inversion does not validate arbitrary concentrations.

Cell record19 uses a supplied replacement with unresolved acquisition provenance; the provenance conflict is identified in Hardware Discussion and the research audit; the figure caption states the supplied replacement.
No validated end-to-end odor classification or independently replicated cellular response.
criteria.status: Concrete proof-of-concept and documentation; limited usability/generalization evidence.

criteria.rule: Evaluate reciprocal learning, reusable documentation, thoughtful implementation and participation in synthetic biology.
local_evidence: Survey of300 respondents informed teaching priorities.
22camp worksheets:13named something learned and9described enjoyment only; feedback records difficulty and length.
LearningLab claims500+participants; feedback led to shorter text, clearer sections and adjusted difficulty.
A teacher toolkit was prepared after a principal requested continued use.
criteria.not_verified: Learning claims require actual participant/educator feedback and usable teaching artifacts; participation counts alone do not demonstrate learning.
criteria.status: Relevant dialogue/reuse evidence present; quantified learning outcomes and artifact verification remain separate checks. Education content was not edited.
gaps: Self-reported worksheets do not establish individual learning gain.
LearningLab participation compared with a separate300-person survey is not automatically a matched before/after study.
Reach and participation counts alone do not demonstrate reciprocal learning; preserve actual feedback-to-design links.
